QUOTE: ret & 0xFF80 → mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) ... ret & ~0xFF80 → mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret) ... join: "HIGH : LOW" (or just one part if the other is zero)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a code is split into high-level and low-level parts, each looked up separately, and joined as "HIGH : LOW" when both are present.
